VM - Get list of contexts.vi

Owning Palette: Advanced VarMan VIs

Returns the handles of either all local Variable Contexts or only those contexts belonging to the specified creator.

Click the parameters for more information

 

Creator (all contexts) is optional parameter. If empty string (by default), the VI returns handles of all opened variable contexts. Otherwise, the VI returns handles of contexts that belong to the specified Creator. See VM - Open Context.vi for details.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
array of VC handles.
err code contains a VarMan Engine error code identifying an error. If no error occurred, err code is equal to zero.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains VarMan VI error code identifying an error if any occurred. If no error occurred, it is equal to zero.
source contains the error description and VI location information if an error occurred.
